name: registry-source
description: Read component registries from the source instead of from memory. An MCP server exposing live list/search/get across the free shadcn-compatible registries (Aceternity, shadcn, Magic UI, ReUI's MIT source), cached 24h with the source URL, fetch date and a stale flag returned on every answer. Flags components that pull a 3D/particle runtime so a block's bundle cost is known before it is installed. Never holds or forges a licence key.
